description: Send the double opt-in confirmation email again to pending subscribers of an audience. Each call emails real subscribers. Without subscriber_ids it emails every eligible pending subscriber, at most 500 per call; remaining says how many are left. A subscriber is emailed only when they signed up at most 30 days ago, had fewer than 3 resends, and got no confirmation email in the last 24 hours. Each email carries a new link valid 7 days, and the old link stops working.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

subscriber_ids.description: Pending subscribers to email. Omit to email every eligible pending subscriber, at most 500 per call.

name: shipmail_resend_subscriber_confirmation
title: Resend Subscriber Confirmation
